title: ZIA rule label limits and constraints

prose.text: Sizes first. {{tenant-limit-listed}} What that number counts is not clear from the page (gap `tenant-cap`), and there is a separate per-rule question (gap `per-rule-label-cap`), so size label schemes well under 1,024 until it is settled.

prose.label: Provider length checks.
prose.text: {{terraform-length-validation}} Whether the server enforces the same lengths is open {{gap:description-max-length}}.

prose.label: Names.
prose.text: Nothing registered restricts the characters in a name {{gap:name-charset}}. Whether names must be unique is open {{gap:name-uniqueness}}.
The provider documentation and its schema disagree on whether `name` is required {{divergence:name-required}}.
For what the API exposes and how name lookups behave, see [[zia.rule-labels.api-surface]]; for the rule type whose provider docs set a per-rule limit, [[zia.rule-labels.rule-types]].

checks.do: Whether label names are unique in the tenant: key on the label ID, not the name, since names may not be unique.
Whether `name` is set on every label, since the provider documentation and its schema disagree on whether it is required.

tenant-limit-listed.statement: The Ranges & Limitations page lists "Rule Labels" at 1,024 labels, in the group of limits headed "All Policy Rule Types".

terraform-length-validation.statement: The Terraform provider rejects a label `name` longer than 255 characters and a `description` longer than 10240 characters before calling the API.
terraform-length-validation.conditions: Client-side validation only; the server's own limits are not shown.

name-required.summary: The provider documentation calls `name` required while the provider schema marks it optional.

quotes: * `name` - (Required) The name of the devices to be created.

positions.says: The schema entry for name sets Optional with a length check, not Required.

name-required.impact: A configuration without `name` may pass Terraform validation and fail at the API, or create an unnamed label; the contract's own requirement is not stated in the pinned OpenAPI (the create operation has no request body schema).

name-charset.title: Allowed characters in a rule label name
name-charset.blocks: generating label names from ticket IDs or free text without rejections
name-charset.detail: No registered source restricts the character set. The only length limit seen is the provider's 255 (claim terraform-length-validation); the server's own limit is unverified.

name-uniqueness.title: Whether label names must be unique in a tenant
name-uniqueness.blocks: relying on name lookups, imports by name and Terraform data sources returning one label
name-uniqueness.detail: No source says the API rejects a duplicate name. The Go lookup by name returns the first case-insensitive match (see [[zia.rule-labels.api-surface:go-name-lookup]]), so duplicates would not be reported by that client. Create two labels with the same name in a scratch tenant.

description-max-length.title: Server-side maximum length of a label description
description-max-length.blocks: stating the true limit rather than the provider's
description-max-length.detail: The provider validates up to 10240 characters (claim terraform-length-validation); the Ranges & Limitations capture states no description length. Whether the server enforces the same figure is untested.

tenant-cap.title: Whether the 1,024 Rule Labels figure is a tenant-wide cap
tenant-cap.blocks: capacity planning for labels used as ticket or wave tags
tenant-cap.detail: The limits page lists 1,024 labels (claim tenant-limit-listed) but its row is not worded per rule or per tenant, and sits among per-rule limits. Whether it caps labels per tenant, labels per rule, or both is not stated.

per-rule-label-cap.title: Maximum labels on one rule, and rules per label
per-rule-label-cap.blocks: stacking several labels on a rule
per-rule-label-cap.detail: Unverified legacy statement: "No documented cap on the number of labels that can be assigned to a single rule, or the number of rules a single label can reference, was found." The only documented limit found is traffic capture's ([[zia.rule-labels.rule-types:traffic-capture-one-label]]); the 1,024 figure above may be the per-rule number (gap tenant-cap).
